investment_signals.headline: Spotify reported record Q2 revenue and operating income while Premium subscribers reached 300 million.
investment_signals.detail: Q2 revenue was €4,777 million, gross margin 33.4%, operating income €655 million and free cash flow €797 million. MAUs were 777 million and Premium Subscribers 300 million; Premium revenue grew approximately 16% year over year and ARPU grew 7.4% year over year.

investment_signals.headline: Spotify guided to 305 million Premium subscribers and €5.0 billion Q3 revenue.
investment_signals.detail: Q3 guidance was 788 million MAUs, 305 million Premium Subscribers, approximately €5.0 billion revenue, 32.9% gross margin and €670 million operating income. Management continued to expect meaningful year-over-year free-cash-flow growth in 2026.

investment_signals.headline: Spotify linked Premium ARPU growth to price increases while Premium gross margin improved.
investment_signals.detail: Premium ARPU grew 7.4% year over year in Q2. Q2 gross margin was 33.4%, a record, and management said product optimization and ad-load changes in select emerging markets were intended to improve conversion and revenue over time.

investment_signals.headline: Spotify announced availability of legendary MTV VMA performances on the service.
investment_signals.detail: The newsroom post is product/content news and does not report a subscription price change. It is included as a daily-monitoring check because it is new since the prior baseline date.

key_findings: Q2 2026 Premium subscribers reached 300M and MAUs 777M (https://s29.q4cdn.com/175625835/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/Q2-2026-Shareholder-Deck-FINAL.pdf).
Q2 revenue was €4,777M, gross margin 33.4%, operating income €655M and FCF €797M (https://s29.q4cdn.com/175625835/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/Q2-2026-Shareholder-Deck-FINAL.pdf).
Premium ARPU grew 7.4% Y/Y in Q2, linking monetization to price/mix (https://s29.q4cdn.com/175625835/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/Q2-26-Earnings-Call-Prepared-Remarks.pdf).

Q3 guidance called for 305M Premium subscribers, €5.0B revenue, 32.9% gross margin and €670M operating income (https://s29.q4cdn.com/175625835/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/Q2-26-Earnings-Call-Prepared-Remarks.pdf).

US Spotify Individual is $12.99/month versus Apple Music $11.99 and YouTube Premium $15.99, all pages retrieved 2026-09-26 (https://www.spotify.com/us/premium/; https://www.apple.com/apple-music/; https://www.youtube.com/premium).
analyst_summary.hike_pattern: The fetched official August 4, 2025 post says price updates were sent across South Asia, the Middle East, Africa, Europe, Latin America and Asia-Pacific, but it does not state old/new prices or effective dates; the January 15, 2026 post covers the US, Estonia and Latvia but likewise omits numeric changes. Therefore cadence, first-moving regions and percentage changes cannot be established without additional dated price-change evidence (https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-08-04/upcoming-changes-to-spotify-premium-subscriptions/; https://newsroom.spotify.com/2026-01-15/premium-pricing-update/).
bull_points: Premium subscribers, revenue, margin, operating income and FCF all grew in Q2 2026 (https://s29.q4cdn.com/175625835/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/Q2-2026-Shareholder-Deck-FINAL.pdf).
Management guided to further subscriber and revenue growth in Q3 (https://s29.q4cdn.com/175625835/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/Q2-26-Earnings-Call-Prepared-Remarks.pdf).
bear_points: The snapshot cannot verify price-change magnitude or churn response because historical old/new prices and country-level churn were not sourced.

Spotify is priced above Apple Music on the captured US Individual recurring price ($12.99 versus $11.99), while YouTube Premium is higher at $15.99 (https://www.spotify.com/us/premium/; https://www.apple.com/apple-music/; https://www.youtube.com/premium).
watch_items_next_5_days: Recheck all localized Spotify /premium pages for price or trial changes on each daily run.
Check Spotify Newsroom and Investor Relations for any new pricing notice or Q3-related release.
Recheck Apple Music/One and YouTube Premium country storefronts for matched or undercutting moves.
Capture iOS App Store and Google Play Spotify ratings/review counts by country.
data_gaps: No complete Spotify price history with old/new values, percent changes, announced/effective dates for the last 24 months was sourced.
No country-level Apple/YouTube localized pricing set, FX rates, or derived USD comparisons.
No consumer reaction store ratings/review counts or price-sentiment sample.
No reliable country-level churn data or consolidated Q2 quarterly ARPU euro amount was found.

run_schedule.weekly_production_schedule: Daily monitoring run at 20:00 UTC; publish one JSON snapshot per date.

implementation_notes: Never carry forward prices; omit a row when the official localized page does not display a price.
Store recurring price separately from introductory/trial text.
Record page retrieval date and exact URL for every row.
Compare each daily snapshot with 2026-09-25 baseline and flag only newly observed changes.
Use official filings for KPI facts and preserve printed units.
